abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to another of your Pokémon that has Energy Link attached to it.

cards.name: Luxury Ball
cards.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If any this card is in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Marley's Request
cards.text: Search your discard pile for 2 different Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and your opponent chooses 1 of them. Put that card into your hand, and discard the other card. (If all Trainer, Supporter, and Stadium cards in your discard pile have the same name, choose 1 of them. Show that card to your opponent and put it into your hand.)

cards.name: Poké Blower +
cards.text: You may play 2 this card at the same time. If you play 1 this card, flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you play 2 this card, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Poké Drawer +
cards.text: You may play 2 this card at the same time. If you play 1 this card, draw a card. If you play 2 this card, search your deck for up to 2 cards, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Poké Healer +
cards.text: You may play 2 this card at the same time. If you play 1 this card, remove 1 damage counter and a Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you play 2 this card, remove 8 damage counters and all Special Conditions from 1 of your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Dusknoir LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Dusknoir. Dusknoir LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Ectoplasm
abilities.text: If Dusknoir is your Active Pokémon and would be Knocked Out by damage from your opponent's attack, you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and put this Pokémon as a Stadium card into play instead of discarding it. This counts as Dusknoir being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card. As long as you have this Pokémon as a Stadium card in play, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon between turns. If another Stadium card comes into play or this Pokémon is discarded by the effects of any attacks, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, Trainer, or Supporter cards, return this Pokémon to your hand.

cards.name: Machamp LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Machamp. Machamp LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.text: As long as Machamp is your Active Pokémon, each of Machamp's attacks does 60 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) and any damage done to Machamp by your opponent's Pokémon is increased by 60 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Strong-Willed
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Machamp would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Machamp is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead.

cards.name: Raichu LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Raichu. Raichu LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Link Lightning
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon onto Raichu and use Voltage Shoot, you may use another attack of Raichu afterward. This power can't be used if Raichu is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Voltage Shoot
attacks.text: Discard 2 Lightning Energy cards from your hand and choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 to that Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.text: All Energy attached to this Pokémon are Fire Energy instead of their usual type.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Big Explosion
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Counting Song
attacks.text: Put up to 3 damage counters on this Pokémon. Then, put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Night Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't attach any Energy cards from their hand to the Active Pokémon during their next turn.

attacks.name: Fastball
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Charge Beam
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
